svg.text: 520 mm long. Square ends; seal the end grain.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each leg: one 9 mm hole 17 mm below its top end for the coach

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolt into the top rail; two 9 mm holes, one above the other,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 162 and 183 mm up, for the low brace.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: each leg lies against the outside face of the top rail

svg.text: and of the low brace, upright, its top just below the panel.
